1753-2023-4289-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

277-413-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
277-413-2577-7084.description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-4677-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-4677-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1765-4247-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4585-6495-6972.easyPrerequisites: There are at least X total creatures on the battlefield.
4585-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Custodi Soulbinders.
When Custodi Soulbinders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
4585-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

997-1981-2415-7452.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

1651-3340-6871-7824.description:
Activate Bootleggers' Stash by tapping it, as it's a land due to Toph, creating two Treasure tokens due to Bard.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Bootleggers' Stash.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1169-3259-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
1169-3259-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-3259-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1169-3259-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

2034-2178-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

5220-5686-7332.description:
Cast Casey & Raph by paying {4}{R}.
When Casey & Raph enters, it triggers. Choose its first mode targeting yourself.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Casey & Raph.
When Casey & Raph dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Casey & Raph onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Resolve the Casey & Raph trigger from step 2, causing you to exile Casey & Raph from the top of your ability with the ability to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Cast Casey & Raph from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

7014-7163-7172.description:
Activate Sunken Palace's second ability by paying {1}{U}, tapping it and exiling seven cards from your graveyard, adding {U}.
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, ensuring to use the mana from Sunken Palace, targeting a triggered ability.
Sunken Palace triggers. Holding priority, activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {1}{R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
Resolve the first Sunken Palace trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting a Sunken Palace trigger.
Resolve the Mister Fantastic ability, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3967-4871-5220-6594.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3967-4871-5220-6594.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

11-5864-6069-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-5864-6069-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Alchemist's Gambit by paying its cleave cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Alchemist's Gambit.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Alchemist's Gambit spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Alchemist's Gambit spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Alchemist's Gambit and returning the original Alchemist's Gambit to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Alchemist's Gambit from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

2173-2292-4616-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

193-1238-6770.easyPrerequisites: You control three creatures with different powers, including Heart of Kiran if Aminatou has two or more loyalty counters on it.
193-1238-6770.description:
If Aminatou has two or more loyalty counters on it, activate Heart of Kiran by removing a loyalty counter from Aminatou, causing Heart of Kiran to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until Aminatou has one loyalty counter on it.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, targeting Redemption Choir.
Aminatou is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Aminatou ability, blinking Redemption Choir.
When Redemption Choir enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Aminatou from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

152-2034-2499-5446.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariot token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers twice, creating four 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Cats, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
152-2034-2499-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Cats and/or target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.

1170-1251-1328-2105.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
1170-1251-1328-2105.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

3525-4720-4893-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
3525-4720-4893-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

719-3197-4304.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Bear" chosen.
719-3197-4304.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Herd Baloth enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Xenograft, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Xenograft, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 3.

293-5147-5220-5716.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Selhoff Occultist and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Selhoff Occultist trigger, causing you to mill Narcomoeba from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact with MV<=2 that has a generic mana cost

997-1393-2364-4986--31.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Aether Channeler, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=2 by paying at most {2}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Aether Channeler, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Mana Vault by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2-2557-5637.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1339-2034-3594-4499.notablePrerequisites: Toothy has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1339-2034-3594-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Toothy.
When Toothy leaves and enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to draw at least two cards.
Toothy's first ability and The Locust God trigger for each card drawn.
Resolve all Toothy triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve all Locust God triggers, creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Insects, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1283-1645-1765-2034.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {1}, attaching it to Chishiro.
When Crown of Flames enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {2}.
Activate Crown of Flames's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2178-2532-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Jaxis.
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2178-2532-5231.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Thermopod with haste.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Thermopod token, adding {R}.
The Thermopod token dies, triggering itself and Jaxis.
Resolve the Thermopod token's trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Jaxis trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

575-2348-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
575-2348-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 2/2 creature due to Nature's Revolt.
Repeat.

1424-2178-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff and Presence of Gond attached to the same creature.
The creature does not have summoning sickness.
1424-2178-5256.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Elf Warrior token.
The creature with Thornbite Staff equipped triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Elf Warrior's power.
Repeat.
